app_behavior.rule: This pin is the authority for native behavior only. A branch name is never sufficient evidence for a public claim.

privacy_claims.publication_rule: A privacy change may be published only after the pinned notice has completed the required content review and its digest is recorded here.

operational_attestation.rule: Setting this deadline is not an operational attestation. Before a public privacy release, the designated owner must record evidence for every required scope; if any served numerical claim is inaccurate, the attestation must list that exact served route and wording before an interim correction and its separately approved release evidence are allowed.

interim_correction.rule: Use only after a named owner attests that a specific currently served claim is inaccurate. Every affected claim must exactly match an entry in the attestation's attested_inaccurate_claims list and retain exact wording, separate production approval, validation, and rollback evidence; this path is intentionally independent of the full replacement gate.

privacy_publication_gate.rule: A public privacy release must use --require-public-privacy-ready and remains blocked until the native notice and tester-program addendum are reviewed, legacy surfaces have a recorded disposition, an approved replacement source exists, and the owner attestation is recorded.

non_authoritative_status_records.reason: The statement names neither an exact version nor a signed artifact. It cannot govern a public release claim.

release_claims.publication_rule: A recorded read-only Play Console observation is sufficient only for an availability claim about its exact version and track. Artifact provenance is sufficient only for a code-content claim about its exact version. A compound availability-and-content claim requires both gates. Unversioned project-status narrative is context only and cannot override these records.

portal_surface.rule: This pin owns protected portal implementation only. It does not define native behavior, privacy text, or app release facts.

deployment.rule: A live artifact must be identified by a deployment manifest containing its source commit, artifact digest, verification record, and rollback reference; it is never inferred from branch names or similar markup.
